partition.algorithm: For each official JSON file independently, rank example keys by SHA-256(seed + NUL + file name + NUL + example key). The first 20 ranks are development-visible and the remaining 80 are sealed fresh members.
partition.stratification: Each of the 79 official generator configurations contributes exactly 20 development and 80 fresh cases.

development.visibility: question, query, reference proof, and the attached in-context demonstrations may be inspected for adapter validation and failure clustering

trainingVisibleDemonstrations.membership: Only demonstrations attached to development members are training-visible. They are never counted as independent official test cases.

fresh.visibility: sealed membership only; adapter v1 exports no fresh-case loader and no fresh text, reference proof, or per-case outcome

baselineSample.algorithm: Within the 20 development cases in each official file, rank stable IDs by SHA-256(seed + NUL + stable ID) and select the first two.

oracleIsolation.visiblePool: contains context, query, typed finite-entailment task, and generator-configuration metadata, but no reference proof
oracleIsolation.hostOracle: contains the stable case ID, expected entailment, and official reference proof in a separate array
oracleIsolation.trainingPool: may be requested explicitly and contains only the in-context demonstrations attached to development members
oracleIsolation.freshPool: does not exist in the exported adapter interface
